testdescription: Control point: execute actual canonical write paths with the exact dual-gate matrix and safe, unsafe, and missing external configuration; for both-enabled valid live composition, touch Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View identities and inject provider, persistence, and queryability failures. Observation point: readiness invalidates first and exact touched IDs are returned; both-disabled produces explicit Pending or Stale and zero provider/vector work; half-enabled or unsafe/missing configuration fails closed with redacted action and zero provider/vector writes; both-enabled valid execution uses approved finite 1024-dimensional Qwen vectors, durably upserts or tombstones complete evidence, verifies all touched records through vector indexes, and reports Aligned only after global coherence; failures retain canonical authority, record Stale or Failed, and block semantic query; production performs no runId cleanup.

Control point: invoke canonical argo init into the private WP-P1 full-reconciliation composition after same-version structural projection; interrupt a bounded batch, inject isolated record failure, resume, rerun unchanged, and inspect public discovery/routing. Observation point: all three channels are independently enumerated, complete metadata and vectors are durably upserted, checkpoints survive, resume does not repeat completed provider/upsert identities, rerun is idempotent, failure remains non-Aligned, no fake canonical mutation or production cleanup occurs, readiness waits for queryability/global coherence, and no standalone public backfill tool exists.

Control point: through controlled production composition, execute batch and focused add/update/remove mutations for Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View, restart durable state, and run unrelated test-only live-E2E cleanup; separately exercise dual-gated live composition when the protected environment exists. Observation point: exact touched changed identities are durably upserted, exact removed identities are tombstoned, unchanged records survive restart, complete canonical/content/index/provider/model/version/dimensions/vector evidence remains subordinate to canonical JSON, production exposes no runId cleanup behavior, test-only cleanup cannot select production identities, disabled gates make zero vector calls, and partial vector failure records Failed or Stale for later init reconciliation.

Control point: invoke ordinary typed queries only through public getSystemArchitecture(query) against aligned, disabled, pending, partial, stale, failed, and mismatched durable states; invoke omitted-query and graph-tidy controls. Observation point: each ordinary query freshly verifies readiness before provider/vector work; non-Aligned states reject with fullSnapshotFallback:false; Aligned performs qualified embedding and independent exhaustive Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View vector retrieval followed by deterministic closure and canonical completion; no public readiness tool, injected retrieval boundary, synthetic empty seeds, or fallback exists; omitted-query and graph-tidy perform zero semantic operations.

Control point: after successful canonical mutation with injected provider, persistence, partial-channel, and queryability failures, invoke getSystemArchitecture(query) repeatedly in disabled, Pending, partial, Stale, Failed, unknown, version-mismatched, and Aligned states; then run valid resumable argo init reconciliation and repeat. Invoke no-argument and graph-tidy controls throughout. Observation point: every semantic query freshly reads persistent readiness before provider/vector work, each non-Aligned state rejects with exact redacted state/version/channel evidence and fullSnapshotFallback:false, canonical JSON remains authoritative, no false readiness occurs, later full three-channel reconciliation alone restores Aligned, and no-argument plus graph-tidy retain exact canonical bypass behavior.

Control point: invoke canonical argo init for both gates exactly enabled with valid controlled production configuration, both disabled, each half-enabled combination, missing and unsafe external configuration, interrupted reconciliation resume, unchanged rerun, and rerun of a prior structural-only project; inspect public tools/list and routing. Observation point: enabled+valid runs full idempotent/resumable Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View reconciliation and records readiness only after durable queryability/global coherence; disabled completes structural-only with explicit Disabled/Pending evidence and zero provider/vector effects; half-enabled or unsafe/missing fails closed with redacted action, zero provider/vector writes, and no false readiness; rerun resumes or aligns; canonical init semantics remain explicit; the three standalone lifecycle tools are absent publicly.
